rules.title: FLSA — Hours Worked Standard

params.notes: Hours worked = time the employee is suffered or permitted to work; the Portal-to-Portal Act excludes ordinary commuting and activities preliminary or postliminary to the principal activity (incl. security screening, Integrity Staffing v. Busk 2014); 29 CFR 785.47 lets insubstantial, irregular minutes be disregarded

result.summary: Under the FLSA all time an employee is suffered or permitted to work is paid, except ordinary commuting and preliminary or postliminary activities excluded by the Portal-to-Portal Act; a de minimis exception exists.

rules.title: FLSA — Travel Time (Commute)

result.summary: Ordinary home-to-work travel is not hours worked, even to different worksites, unless the employee works during the trip.

rules.title: FLSA — Travel Time (Between Worksites)

result.summary: Travel between job sites during the workday, or from the employer's premises to the first site after reporting, is hours worked.

rules.title: FLSA — Travel Time (Special One Day Assignment)

params.notes: Employer may deduct the normal home-to-work commute time

result.summary: A special one-day assignment in another city is hours worked, less the time of the employee's normal commute.

rules.title: FLSA — Travel Time (Out Of Town)

result.summary: Overnight travel away from home is hours worked only during the employee's normal working hours (including corresponding hours on non-working days); passenger time outside those hours is unpaid unless work is done.

rules.title: FLSA — Travel Time (Employer Mandated Transport)

result.summary: Riding employer-provided transport from a meeting point to the worksite is not hours worked under the Portal-to-Portal Act unless the travel is itself a principal activity; several states (CA, NY, WA, MD, PA, MA) count it.

rules.title: FLSA — Restricted On-Call Time

params.test: engaged to wait: employee must remain on the premises or so close that the time cannot be used effectively for personal purposes

result.summary: An employee required to stay on or near the premises while on call is working and must be paid.

rules.title: FLSA — Unrestricted On-Call Time

params.test: waiting to be engaged: employee may leave a contact number and use the time for personal purposes
params.notes: Time actually spent responding to calls is paid

result.summary: An on-call employee who need only leave a contact number and can use the time freely is not working; only time responding to calls is paid.

rules.title: FLSA — Mandatory Training and Meetings

params.notes: Attendance is not voluntary if required or if the employee is led to believe non-attendance would hurt their job

result.summary: Required training, orientation and meetings are hours worked.

rules.title: FLSA — Voluntary Training Outside Hours

params.exclusion_test: all four: outside regular hours, genuinely voluntary, not directly related to the employee's current job, and no productive work performed
params.notes: Training to acquire a new or additional skill is not 'directly related'; apprenticeship instruction and independent courses are excluded

result.summary: Training is unpaid only when it is outside regular hours, voluntary, not directly related to the current job and involves no productive work; otherwise it is hours worked.

rules.title: FLSA — Time Clock Rounding

params.notes: Rounding to the nearest 5, 6 or 15 minutes is accepted where it averages out and does not fail to pay for all time actually worked over a period

result.summary: Punches may be rounded to the nearest quarter hour (or smaller increment) if the practice is neutral and does not, over time, fail to pay employees for all hours worked.

rules.title: Illinois — Hours Worked Standard

result.summary: Illinois defines hours worked as all time the employee is required to be on duty or at a prescribed workplace, including travel between worksites and required training, close to federal practice.

rules.title: Illinois — Travel Time (Between Worksites)

result.summary: Travel between worksites during the workday is hours worked.
